fusions.name: Hafted Javelin
fusions.desc: Hurls the blade on a long haft, dealing 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Long Reach Hew
fusions.desc: A long-hafted chop at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Lengthened Haft
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Ready the Throw
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
